name: Leadership Scholars
city: New York City (all five boroughs) and Newark, NJ
what_you_do: A year-long after-school program on leadership and life after high school. You practice public speaking, learn about college and career paths and meet professionals.
who_can_apply: Young women and gender-expansive youth in 10th or 11th grade who live in New York City or Newark and can come in person once a week. No academic rules.
pay_detail: Up to $400 at the end of the semester, based on participation.
duration: Thursdays 4:30 to 6:30 p.m., November to May, in person at the New York City or Newark office.
how_to_apply: Apply online with the link on the Leadership Scholars page. Questions: Charlie Ambrose, charlie@sadienash.org (listed on the page).
notes: The page lists the New York City office at 247 W 37th Street, Suite 705, New York, NY 10018. Stipend is based on participation.
